articles.title: Google Play now lets anyone build private, vibe-coded apps that run on Android
articles.description: Google is making it easier to build and use personal Android apps created with AI, without having to make them available to everyone on the Play Store.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: SpaceX and Google both said no. Now his software is riding a SpaceX rocket next to Google’s
articles.description: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Cerebras CEO pushes back on AI doomsday warnings
articles.description: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman has a message for AI leaders spreading doomsday warnings: Maybe stop talking? At TechCrunch Disrupt, he argued that the industry's focus on AI's risks is drowning out its potential benefits.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
articles.description: American Express is introducing a new framework designed to ensure AI agents only make purchases their users have authorized, potentially preventing costly mistakes and disputes as AI-powered shopping grows.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
articles.description: The founders detailed how their startup is developing AI that can design chips, learn from each iteration, and improve subsequent designs, all with the goal of automating and accelerating the chip design process.
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Science Corporation implants its vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient
articles.description: Max Hodak, the former president and co-founder of Neuralink, detailed onstage at TechCrunch Disrupt how his company's work with PRIMA is part of its path toward a novel brain-computer interface (BCI).
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
articles.description: The startup will sell some of its assets to Disney for $20 million.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
articles.description: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer with Anthropic.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec, Lucas Ropek, Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
articles.description: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay sees a future where AI devices replace the need to use apps
articles.description: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI devices work in the background, anticipating users' needs instead of waiting for commands.
articles.author: Sarah Perez
